text: 【沈鼓集团：首次公开发行股票并在主板上市】沈鼓集团(601091.SH)公告称，公司首次公开发行股票并在主板上市的申请已获证监会同意注册。本次公开发行股票数量为3.11亿股，占发行后总股本的10%，发行价格为4.39元/股，发行市盈率29.81倍。
text_en: [Shengu Group: Initial public offering and listing on the main board] Shengu Group (601091.SH) announced that its application for an initial public offering and listing on the main board has been approved for registration by the CSRC. The number of shares in this public offering is 311 million, accounting for 10% of the total share capital after issuance, with an issue price of 4.39 yuan per share and an issue price-to-earnings ratio of 29.81 times.
